translated_text: I bow to the Arihants (destroyers of enemies), to the Siddhas (liberated beings), to the Acharyas (spiritual leaders), to the Upadhyayas (teachers), and to all the Sadhus (monks) of the world.
original_text: Namo Arihantanam, Namo Siddhanam, Namo Ayariyanam, Namo Uvajjhayanam, Namo Loe Savva Sahunam.

translated_text: These five reverences destroy all sins.
original_text: Eso Panch Namokkaro, Savva Pavappanasano,

translated_text: Among all auspicious things, this is the foremost auspiciousness.
original_text: Mangalanam Cha Savvesim, Padhamam Havai Mangalam.

translated_text: Gather the teachings of the Agamas, so that non-violence may prevail.
original_text: Agamasuttam samāhāra, jēṇa hōi avihaṃsā.

translated_text: The doctrines of the Jinas are like a raft; practice their teaching.
original_text: Sāriṭṭhā jiṇasuttāṇaṃ, tāṇaṃ sikkhā padipajjā.

translated_text: The Dhamma is not attained merely by study.
original_text: Na hi sajjhāya mātreṇa, dhammo tīre ṇijjharī.

translated_text: The industrious person progresses, following the command.
original_text: Vīriyavā pūsai, suhāvā āņattī.

translated_text: Non-violence is the supreme religion.
original_text: Ahimsā paramo dharmaḥ.

translated_text: Just as life should protect life, wherever living beings exist.
original_text: Jīvā jīvantānaṃ, jaha jaha jīvanti, taha taha rakkhā kappejja.

translated_text: May all living beings be happy, may all beings be free from suffering.
original_text: Sabbā jīvā sukhī hontu, dukkhā muñcantu sabba jīvā.

translated_text: One crosses the cycle of existence through faith and effort.
original_text: Saṃsārā pāramitā hōi, jēṇa saddhā viriyavā.

translated_text: Gather the light of wisdom, the eye of the human world.
original_text: Cakkhavāhiṃ samāhāra, cakkhu māṇussalokassa.

translated_text: I go to the Dhamma as my refuge, I go to the community as my refuge.
original_text: Dhammo haṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, saṅkham saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.

translated_text: The land of heroes, the hero's religion, the hero's virtue.
original_text: Vīratā vīra bhūmī cā, vīra dhammā vīratā gunā.

translated_text: By whatever endeavor, by that shall the fruit come.
original_text: Jēṇa jēṇa samārambhō, tēṇa tēṇa phalō bhavē.

translated_text: The Dhamma protects those who protect it.
original_text: Dhammō rakhatī rakṣitā, dharmō rakṣati rakṣitāḥ.

translated_text: Non-violence is the supreme religion, as said in other scriptures.
original_text: Ahimsā paramo dharmaḥ, tathā cānye pavacane.

translated_text: Always work for the welfare of all beings, step by step.
original_text: Sattva hitāya satataṃ, kurvita kramaśo budhaḥ.

translated_text: By exertion, by diligence, by association, and by strength.

original_text: Cariyā cāraviraha, cāraṇā cāragāmī.

translated_text: Compassion for all beings is the supreme religion.
original_text: Sattva dayā paramo dharmaḥ, tathā cānye pavacane.

translated_text: He who has boundless energy, that being abandons all suffering.
original_text: Anantavīriyā jēṇa, sō sattō sabbadukkhapahā.

translated_text: Where there is vision, there is body; where there is perception, there is the soul.
original_text: Jaha cakkhu taha sarīraṃ, jaha sañjñā taha jīva.

translated_text: All conditions arise and cease; impermanent are the conditioned forms.
original_text: Uppāda ṇirodhā dhammā, aniccā saṅkhatā rūpā.

translated_text: One should not cause violence, should abandon fraudulent practices.
original_text: Na himsā kārayet kascit, kūṭasthānaṃ parityajet.

translated_text: Morality, meditation, and insight — realize their great fruit.
original_text: Sīlaṃ samādhiṃ vipassanaṃ, sambhāvehi mahāphale.

translated_text: The one who is single-pointed and unified speaks with clarity.
original_text: Ekakkhī hōi saṃbhinnō, suviññeyō ca bhāsati.

translated_text: Life after life, in the Dhamma, by one's own effort.
original_text: Pavvaya pavvaya dhammē, sahāvē sāhāvē sē.

translated_text: The soul, the non-soul, karma, defilement, bondage.
original_text: Jīvā ajīvā karmāsaṅkileśa bandha.

original_text: Mokkho sabbakammakṣayo.

original_text: Sammattā ṇijjarā mokkō, āyariyā ṇijjarā mokkō.
